purpose: The single source of truth for behavioural clause failures the owner has accepted as open in docs/runtime-wall-trace.json. Read by scripts/build.mjs (the release gate) and by tests/runtime-evidence-binding.test.mjs (the tripwire), so the build and the tripwire cannot disagree about what is recorded.
owner_decision: 2026-09-21 — release gate semantics. The default build passes when there is no UNRECORDED gate failure and gate.timing_and_dli_passed is true. A new failure, or a recorded failure that silently disappears, fails the build exactly as it fails the tripwire. gate.passed keeps its meaning: false while any failure is recorded.

classes.a-stale-scenario: (a) The scenario cannot contain the behaviour; the assertion is right. Fixed by extending the scenario, never by loosening the assertion — recorded when extending is not cheap.
classes.b-wrong-selection: (b) The clause reads the wrong coverage; fixed by correcting the selection and proving the corrected clause still fails when the behaviour is missing.
classes.c-real-failure: (c) A real failure of the build. Neither fixed nor weakened here; recorded so the evidence stays a truthful description of the build.
classes.pre-existing-unclassified: Pre-existing failure carried unchanged; no session has classified it into (a), (b) or (c) yet.
